messages:
sylvia (infra): Planning a consolidation + thermal calibration pass next Wed 23:00-05:00 UTC. It's a rolling drain + BIOS bump + graceful reboot. Goal: free space for new pod types and normalize thermal behavior.
tom (sre): Which regions/racks? any high-risk tenants?
sylvia (infra): Affected: us-east2-grid (cohort 1), eu-north-slate (cohort 2), apac-east2-edge (cohort 3 small). We'll avoid premium tenants where possible.
anya (oncall): How big are cohorts? pref for shorter windows to reduce tail risk.
sylvia (infra): Cohorts of ~20 racks, 90m per cohort (evacuate 15m, BIOS/drain+reboot 45m, post-backfill 30m). We'll run 2 parallel cohorts max in different regions.
leo (network): We'll need to toggle egress shaping for a subset of racks during backfill. I'll stage ACLs and a canary test before cohort start.
mohit (prod-eng): Any API or model-level changes? Some teams saw higher tail latency in last run.
sylvia (infra): No API surface changes. Tail latency risk mitigations: pre-seed KV and cap burst backfill to 10% regional extra capacity.
tom (sre): Cost estimate? last time backfill spiked unexpectedly.
sylvia (infra): Rough estimate: $2.2k total if we stay within burst caps. If we break burst cap, costs could double. Backfill policy will enforce reserved cap.
ops-bot: Reminder: run `./bin/preflight-checks --cohorts 1,2,3` 25m before start.
anya (oncall): Rollback criteria? I want clear SLO thresholds.
sylvia (infra): Abort if failed tasks exceed 2% of cohort baseline or 5xxs jump >1.8x sustained for 4m. Rollback steps: revert BIOS, reattach QoS, rehydrate from latest snapshot, requeue tasks to warm pool.
leo (network): If BGP flaps during egress ACL apply, we'll pause and demote cohort to manual.
mohit (prod-eng): Can product flag endpoints to avoid eviction? We'll mark 3 critical routes; please pin them.
anya (oncall): @mohit list the routes in the PR and tag me. We'll ensure pinning before cordon.
sylvia (infra): Evac commands (short):
 - cohortctl cordon <id>
 - cohortctl drain --grace 900 --evict-bulk
 - cohortctl bios-update --batch 8
 - cohortctl reboot --rate 3/rack
 - cohortctl uncordon && kvseed --batch top50
tom (sre): Pre-warm note: we'll run kvseed for top50 prefixes 10m before cohort finishes to reduce cold-cache tails.
ops-bot: Canary tests scheduled: net-canary on eu-north-slate at 22:30 UTC, workload-canary on us-east2-grid at 22:40 UTC.
leo (network): I'll monitor per-cohort egress and BGP. If attach time >4m, hold cohort.
anya (oncall): Who's primary comms during the window?
sylvia (infra): Tom primary, Anya secondary, Leo for network, Mohit for product liasons. I'll post the full cohort mapping 48h out.
mohit (prod-eng): Noted. I'll also add a short customer status blurb: "We are performing infrastructure tuning; intermittent latency increases possible."
status-bot: Maintenance ticket created MNT-2026-204. Customer banner queued.
tom (sre): Quick checklist I'll run at start: snapshot fleet-state, disable automatic autoscale across cohorts, lock burst policy, run preflight.
sylvia (infra): Risk: a small subset of apac-east2 BMCs run older firmware and may need manual verification after reboot. We'll skip auto power-cycles for those nodes.
anya (oncall): If we hit manual BMC handoffs, extend window and notify customers.
leo (network): I'll stage ACL diff in the repo and ping here when canary passes.
sylvia (infra): Thanks — closing for now. Please ping if you need cohort swaps or tenant exemptions.
